GnRH cells originate from the anterior pitutary placode and the cranial neural crest and migrate to their final destination in the brain.

the embryonic origins, migration and fate of GnRH neurons.

GnRH cells originate in multiple locations and migrate extensively throughout the embryo to reach their final destinations.
the embryonic origin of GnRH cells is not restricted to the olfactory placodal domain, and GnRH cells are not necessarily olfactory.
